designationHistory.name: Izembek National Wildlife Range
designationHistory.indexText: Secretary of the Interior Fred A. Seaton signed Public Land Order 2216 establishing the Izembek National Wildlife Range on the Alaska Peninsula as a refuge, breeding ground and management area for wildlife.
designationHistory.note: The FWS CCP says ANILCA (1980) renamed the range Izembek National Wildlife Refuge; that step was not separately verified here.
